title: The autopilot manager runs sprints within its authority
goal: A manager session plans, starts, runs, reviews and closes sprints headless within its authority: it answers gates as recorded decisions the operator ratifies from a digest, starts a sprint only after its research, keeps its state in one capped command, runs sprint runners that restart and share one host, and reports context rot and decision disagreement
